description: Product-selling page — for requests implying items for sale (bakery with online ordering, shop, store, product catalog).

default_sections.purpose: Brand/shop name + short tagline + shop-now CTA
default_sections.fill_guidance: Keep commerce-forward — this hero should point at browsing/buying, not just describe the brand.
Grid of product cards (image, name, price). Use plausible generic items matching the stated subject (e.g. bakery → croissant, sourdough loaf, cupcake) with placeholder prices.
Include for small/local businesses where a brand story adds trust (bakery, boutique). Skip for generic/large-catalog stores.
Include if trust/quality is a likely selling point for the subject (food, handmade goods).
Include for anything implying a physical presence (bakery, local shop). Omit for a purely digital product store.
Shop, sections present, Cart/Contact as applicable.

notes: This is the archetype that should catch the 'bakery' example from earlier testing — bakery implies physical products, so this fits better than a generic landing-page for most bakery requests unless the user clarifies it's purely informational.
Product images are a known weak point without a real catalog — flag generated product entries as placeholder content, not final copy.
